contractName: Source Document Lifecycle & State Isolation Contract
description: Enforces strict cryptographic boundary between discovered URLs and verified ingested documents.

states.URL_FOUND: URL has been discovered from web/portal scrape. No file bytes or hash verified. Cannot back official rules.
states.METADATA_INDEXED: HTTP headers or notice metadata indexed. File content unverified.
states.BYTES_INGESTED: Raw binary stream downloaded and stored in staging buffer. Hash pending.
states.SHA_VERIFIED: Cryptographic SHA-256 computed on bytes and matched against authority/immutable record. Only this state can back canonical events and rules.

isolationRules: A document with sourceState === URL_FOUND retains URL_FOUND even if caller supplies shaVerified: true.
documentSha256 is stripped to null if state is URL_FOUND or METADATA_INDEXED.
SHA_VERIFIED requires valid 64-character lowercase hex string matching /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.
